Carousel1.intro: Part of the Sustainable Energy Digital Intelligence Platform
Carousel1.title: Energy for Development
Carousel1.list: <item>The <bold> Sustainable Energy Academy</bold> - Dive into thought leadership, data visualization, and over 40 hours of expert-led content across 8 modules exploring the Energy for Development pathway</item><item><bold>Energy AI and Knowledge Graph</bold>  - Leverage the power of AI and interconnected data to uncover insights, drive smarter decisions, and accelerate sustainable energy solutions.</item><item><bold>Geospatial Data</bold> - Access spatial data to analyze energy access, identify equity gaps, and pinpoint opportunities for targeted action—right at your fingertips.</item>

Carousel2.intro: FOCUS AREA OF THE SUSTAINABLE ENERGY ACADEMY
Carousel2.title: Energy for Development
Carousel2.list: <item><bold>Close the gap in energy access</bold> so that marginalized people and communities gain access to sustainable, clean, energy and the dignity and opportunities it brings.</item><item><bold>Accelerate energy transition</bold> through system changes that support a green recovery and improve efficiency by bringing together the best ideas from government, private sector, finance, digital, and civil society.</item><item><bold>Catalyze energy finance</bold> by working with the public sector and global, regional, and local financial ecosystems to scale up public and private investments. </item>

Invitation.body: Welcome to the <bold>Sustainable Energy Digital Intelligence Platform</bold>, an innovative tool for driving system transformation through data-driven and integrated strategies to scale progress towards an inclusive and just sustainable energy transition.

ModulesFeature.title: Explore the Academy digital learning platform with 8 interactive e-modules
ModulesFeature.body: Dive into more than 40 hours of expert-written content and thought leadership. Discover 80 infographics and 60 data visualizations that bring energy trends to life. Learn from 70 real-world case studies highlighting impactful sustainable energy solutions. Earn a certificate for every module you finish!

KnowledgeGraph.title: When in need, ask the Energy AI and Knowledge Graph
KnowledgeGraph.body: The platform provides data-driven insights and learning experience through the AI and knowledge graph tool, trained on a custom database of energy policies and resources, and accessible through a dynamic interface to move beyond chat alone and dive into the integrated approach on sustainable energy for development.
